reason: Owner requires OSS-first to be a mechanically enforced repository rule for all future development. Prior implementation PR #282 proved the policy/test logic but final route-coverage verification found that Stage's existing GOVERNANCE_WP0 job does not execute the new OSS-first WP0 test. #282 was therefore closed unmerged. This successor closes that exact coverage gap by reusing the existing Stage governance job and its already-executed implementation-branch-policy regression seam: failure-first requires the governance workflow to invoke the OSS-first test, then the existing workflow gets one explicit test invocation while the policy SSOT and OSS-first validator are added. No new workflow, policy engine, service, dependency, or CI framework is introduced.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: The existing implementation-branch-policy regression suite must prove that GOVERNANCE_WP0 explicitly invokes tests/wp0/oss-first-development-policy.test.js; the current trusted-main workflow must be RED against that requirement.
The repair must add exactly one OSS-first test invocation to the existing wp0-governance job and must not create another workflow, route, policy engine, service, or dependency.
The OSS-first validator must inspect authorization JSON files added or modified relative to trusted main and require auditable ossFit evidence before implementation.
Historical already-merged authorization documents are grandfathered and must not be retroactively invalidated.
Future authorization proposals missing required ossFit evidence must make the existing Stage GOVERNANCE_WP0 route fail closed.

RED repair itself must require OSS-fit re-evaluation; when mature OSS can replace equivalent Yance self-built infrastructure, the authorization must prefer adoption/porting and state retirement/avoidance.
